description: React component for managing and displaying a video library with upload, polling, and actions like view, download, and delete.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches the list of videos from the API and maps server response to UI shape.

methods.name: onUpload
methods.description: Handles video file upload, updates state, and triggers reload.

methods.name: setRowActionLoading
methods.description: Sets loading state for specific row actions.

methods.name: handleView
methods.description: Opens the generated sheet in a new tab/window based on API response.

methods.name: handleDownload
methods.description: Downloads the generated sheet or video data.

methods.name: handleDelete
methods.description: Deletes a video record after user confirmation.

methods.name: getUploadStatus
methods.description: Determines upload progress label and color.

methods.name: getDetectionStatus
methods.description: Determines detection processing status label and color.

methods.name: getActionButtonStyle
methods.description: Returns style for action buttons based on hover and loading states.
